units.source_text: 知道实情的人，对此深表同情。

en.t: Those who knew the truth felt deep sympathy over this.

units.source_text: 那天晚上悄悄讥评的那两个侍女，心中更是难过，

en.t: The two gentlewomen who had whispered criticism that night felt even more distressed,

units.source_text: 大家唉声叹气，悔不该私议此种隐事，以致惹起口舌。

en.t: and everyone sighed, regretting that they had privately discussed such a hidden matter and stirred up gossip.

units.source_text: 云居雁本人则一概不知，依然天真烂漫。

en.t: Kumoi no Kari herself knew nothing of it and remained as innocent and carefree as ever.

units.source_text: 父亲向她房中窥探一下，看见她那模样非常可爱，又觉得此人甚是可怜。

en.t: Her father peered into her room, and seeing how very charming she looked, he also felt deeply sorry for her.

units.source_text: 他埋怨乳母等人说：“我常说她年纪还小，却想不到她竟是如此不懂事理。

en.t: He reproached her nurses and said, "I always said she was still young, but I never imagined she understood so little.

units.source_text: 还一味希望她成人出世呢！

en.t: And yet I kept hoping only that she would grow up and make her way in the world!

units.source_text: 我实在比谁都糊涂了！”

en.t: I have truly been more foolish than anyone!"

units.source_text: 乳母们无言可答，只是私下议论：“此种事情，其实并不稀罕。

en.t: The nurses had no answer, and only spoke among themselves in private: "Such things are not really rare.

units.source_text: 即使是尊贵无比的帝王家的女儿，也不免犯此种过失。

en.t: Even daughters of the most exalted imperial families cannot always avoid this sort of mistake.

units.source_text: 旧小说里常有此种事例。

en.t: Old tales are full of examples like this.

units.source_text: 这往往是知道两人心情的人巧觅机会，暗中拉拢的。

en.t: Usually it happens because someone who knows the feelings of the two people cleverly finds an opportunity and brings them together in secret.

units.source_text: 但我们这里的两个，多年来朝夕共处，年龄又很幼稚，

en.t: But these two here had spent mornings and evenings together for many years, and they were still very young,

units.source_text: 加之有老太太一手照拂，我们怎么可以越俎代庖，出来把他们隔离呢？

en.t: and besides, the old lady was looking after everything herself, so how could we presume to step in and separate them?

units.source_text: 因此我们便疏忽了。

en.t: For that reason we were careless.

units.source_text: 但从前年起，老太太对他们的态度也显然变更，不让他们朝夕共处了。

en.t: But since the year before last, the old lady's attitude toward them had clearly changed, and she no longer let them spend mornings and evenings together.

units.source_text: 有的孩子品行不良，也会巧觅机会，偷偷地干些大人的勾当。

en.t: Some badly behaved children may also cleverly seek out chances to secretly do adult things.

units.source_text: 但夕雾少爷为人正直，我们做梦也想不到他会胡行乱为。

en.t: But young Yugiri is upright by nature, and we never dreamed he would act so recklessly.

units.source_text: 如今竟有此事，真乃出人意外。”

en.t: For such a thing to have happened now is truly beyond expectation."

units.source_text: 说着，私下叹息。

en.t: So saying, they sighed privately.
